title: Lilly's Pad | Santa Rosa Beach, FL | Five Star Properties
meta_description: Lilly’s Pad - Pet-Friendly Luxury Beachview Home with Private Pool in Santa Rosa BeachFavorite Features:- Pets Allowed
description_expanded: Lilly’s Pad - Pet-Friendly Luxury Beachview Home with Private Pool in Santa Rosa Beach Favorite Features: - Pets Allowed - Private Pool (Heat Available) - Gulf View - 5 Minute Walk to Beach - Golf Cart - 4 Bikes Included More about Lilly's Pad: Discover the ultimate coastal escape at Lilly’s Pad, a stunning retreat in Santa Rosa Beach that blends luxury, comfort, and laid-back charm. Designed with families, friend groups, and even four-legged guests in mind, this pet-friendly haven sleeps up to 14 and offers everything you need for a truly unforgettable getaway. Just a breezy 5-minute walk to the sugar-white sands and steps from the vibrant heart of Gulf Place, you’ll have easy access to boutique shopping, local dining, and live entertainment. And with a complimentary golf cart and four bikes included, exploring 30A has never been easier—or more fun. Out back, your own private oasis awaits. Lounge by the sparkling (heat optional) pool, fire up the grill in the showstopping outdoor area—complete with marble finishes and a built-in stainless grill—or dine al fresco as the sun sets over the treetops. Whether it’s a casual lunch or a starlit dinner, this space was made for gathering. Inside, Lilly’s Pad welcomes you with open, sunlit spaces and a calming coastal-chic aesthetic. High ceilings, soft neutral tones, and natural textures set a serene tone, while plush furnishings and stylish touches add comfort and flair. The open-concept layout flows seamlessly from the fully equipped chef’s kitchen to the cozy living and dining areas—perfect for everything from morning coffee to late-night laughs. With thoughtful design, high-end amenities, and an unbeatable location, Lilly’s Pad is more than a vacation home—it’s a place to slow down, reconnect, and make memories that linger long after the tide rolls out. Sleeping Arrangements: FIRST FLOOR Bedroom 1: Queen Bed & Shared Ensuite Bathroom with Shower. SECOND FLOOR Bedroom 2: King Bed & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower. THIRD FLOOR Bedroom 3: King Bed & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower. Bedroom 4: Twin over Twin Bunk Bed. Bedroom 5: King Bed & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower.  Bedroom 6: Queen Bed & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower.
